avis.texte: This stuff is literally magical. Just after a fee uses my pores are noticeably smaller and the texture I was struggling with is basically gone. I also found it helped fade sun spots I had on my nose. The only complaint I have is that it hurts to apply. But if uou pat it in it doesnt hurt nearly as bad. I even have sensitive/reactive skin and this didnt make my skin angry. If you struggle with texture or pores, do yourself a favor and buy this!!
Yes it feel like being stabbed with tiny needles, but also…this is how you know the stuff is legit. It did wonders for snoothing out some textural issues in my 48 year old skin!

I was able to see results in the first week of using this. I have even been told by close friends that they can see a difference in my skin. I recommend it to everyone! It does feel a bit like rubbing fiberglass on your face at first however it gets better over time. I have been using it for almost a year now and love it as its the only product I have ever been able to see real results, I have done everything.

avis.titre: What Is This Magic Sorcery & Where Has It Been 💙
avis.texte: I don't often give out 5 stars BUT this product has (in conjunction with the Medicube peelpads) transformed my skin. After countless sums of money, treatments, prestiege products its clearing out those long stubborn hard to get rid of clogged black/white heads. My skin looks amd feels more smooth, resilient, and my enlarged pores are foing away after a week. The sensation of the exosome-coated Spicule is very different and if you are new to micro needling, this product causes a VERY DIFFERENT SENSATION on your face upon application BUT it works wonders.

Don't be alarmed at the tingling of this product as that means it's working. I put this on at night after washing my face and then a moisturizer and my face has never looked better. It does not burn but just feels like prickling at first but it goes away quickly.

I've been layering targeted actives (like retinal and peptide serums). The exosome shot acts as a booster that helps my other actives work more effectively by supporting deeper skin repair mechanisms. It helps my skin to better absorb moisture to recover more quickly from retinal and acids. This did not burn or sting all- although I'm very used to strong actives and acids. The whole product line is impressive. The brand seems very focused on actives without unnecessary irritants. I woud recommend.

i will preface this by saying i have only used this product once and do not have sensitive skin! i literally thought my face was going to blow up…i kid you not…the best way to describe it was as if i had pop rocks on my skin. THAT BEING SAID im sure its working, however since this was my first use and it was 25 minutes ago & i ended up wiping it all off i don't particularly know what those results would have been. may use again, may not, depends on how tough i am feeling in the moment.
I could barely put on my skin : feels like needles goinginto your skin. I couldn't even rub in the product and got a huge allergic reaction . My face felt tingly for hours .

Im not going to lie this is pretty uncomfortable at first. Once you rub it in and put a moisturizer on top, in generally stops. I hughly suggest doing that before bed because of this. BUT! Be orepared to wake up to visible results. My upper lip looked like it was brand new. I struggle with discoloration there specifically because of enlarged pores. I highly suggest this to anyone looking to help retexturize their pores.

It definitely feels like rubbing insulation on your skin, but it works like a dream! Any time I get cystic acne, I throw some of this on it and by the next day it's like it was never even there. I love love love it!

Woke up to tighter pores and my dry/oily face was more hydrated and less oily. My makeup was dewy all day not greasy like usual, even after an 11 hour shift. What a great start already. I'm excited to continue and see what the long term affect will be.

The spinucles are no joke! I do NOT have sensitive skin by any means but OW!!!!! And when you put products on afterward it still hurts. However it really helped with a disasterous cystic pimple gone wrong i named chernobyl. So i put up with it and would reccommend it

I am not sure if this product worked for me as I have not used it long enough to tell. I had no bad reaction to it or anything… I am sure it is a great product, but when I put it on at night and wake up the next morning- I have to remember to be careful that I rinse my face to ensure the "needles" are all off before I proceed with my morning skincare. I am just not the right customer for this product.

The spicules take some getting used to! But I have super durable skin and love this feeling! It's as if every pore opened up and grabbed everything after that in! Just like it is supposed to! I've had this for a month and already addicted.

This product brightens the face but it feels like 1000 tiny pieces of glass being rubbed into your face. I suggest taking one pump into the palm spreading it and then lightly patting it into the face and neck. Also the same with any product you put on after because that'll sting too. I like the product but wont repurchase because of the hassle.

avis.titre: Noticeable Results After Just One Use!
avis.texte: The Medicube One Day Exosome Shot 7500 impressed me right away. My face instantly felt cleaner and smoother, and I noticed that every product I applied afterward absorbed faster and worked more efficiently. Within a short time, my pores looked visibly smaller, and my overall skin texture improved. It's one of those rare products that actually delivers on its promises. Absolutely worth it!

This has been insanely marketed nonstop and I feel naive or misled, it is really nothing more than water, adenosine and a very useless amount of actives. I should have read what derms are saying. But I will try for a few more days, maybe I'll change my mind....

This has transformed my skin. I cleanse, use the zero pore toning pads, this product, hydrating serum, and lastly moisturizer. When I woke up the next day I looked like a had glass skin and i understood what people say when they say their skin looks supple, my texture seemed toalmost disappear. I made no other changes to my usual routine other than adding this product. Its a must have.

This is a great product. It made my skin look great in just a few days. I ordered another bottle. I also ordered more products from this line. I have been hearing about it for awhile and I'm so glad that I finally ordered it. I'm glad that Ulta finally got these products.

If you have sensitive skin use the weaker version of it in the 2000 PPM. I have been using this for three months now in the evening after I wash my face but before I put on my serum. The results have me very happy as I have an oily face- it helps me absorb my serum better and let my night moisturizer get kindly absorbed instead waking up to an oily face. It tingles and has some sharp feelings while it's working on your face- nothing hurts its akin to sticking your fqce in a freezer- it's stimulating your blood flow. I also use the Age-R Booster Pro on Air Shot mode to maximize everything.
